key.name: window-width
key.description: The width of the main window

key.name: window-height
key.description: The height of the main window

key.name: last-server-url
key.description: The URL of the last connected Nextcloud server

key.name: last-user-id
key.description: The user ID used for the last connection

key.name: last-display-name
key.description: The display name of the last logged in user

key.name: autologin-enabled
key.description: Whether to automatically log in on startup using saved credentials

key.name: last-room-token
key.description: The token of the last opened conversation room

key.name: last-account-id
key.description: The ID of the last active account for multi-account support

key.name: preferred-video-device
key.description: The device path or name of the preferred camera

key.name: preferred-audio-device
key.description: The device path or name of the preferred microphone

key.name: conversation-background
key.description: Background pattern for the message list: 0=Flat, 1=Grid, 2=Hexagons, 3=Isometric, 4=Rhombus, 5=ZigZag, 6=Houndstooth, 7=Herringbone, 8=Stars, 9=Triangles, 10=Waves, 11=Scales, 12=Cross, 13=Mosaic (participant avatars)

key.name: show-participants
key.description: Whether to show the participants list in group conversations

key.name: default-media-action
key.description: Default action for the media button: 0=Attach file, 1=Record voice, 2=Take photo/video

key.name: max-loaded-rooms
key.description: Maximum number of rooms to keep loaded in memory with their messages. Older rooms are evicted when this limit is exceeded.

key.name: background-tab-height-multiplier
key.description: How many viewports worth of messages to keep in backgrounded room tabs. Higher values keep more messages but use more memory.
